hebrewText: וְ/לֹא יָכְלָ֣ה עוֹד֮ הַצְּפִינ/וֹ֒ וַ/תִּֽקַּֽח ל/וֹ֙ תֵּ֣בַת גֹּ֔מֶא וַ/תַּחְמְרָ֥/ה בַ/חֵמָ֖ר וּ/בַ/זָּ֑פֶת וַ/תָּ֤שֶׂם בָּ/הּ֙ אֶת הַ/יֶּ֔לֶד וַ/תָּ֥שֶׂם בַּ/סּ֖וּף עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יְאֹֽר

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
tokens.kjv: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.

tokens.bdb: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
tokens.kjv: again, [idiom] all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), [idiom] once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).

tokens.bdb: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
tokens.kjv: esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place).

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: properly, an absorbent, i.e. the bulrush (from its porosity); specifically the papyrus
properly, to boil up; hence, to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); to smear with pitch
asphalt (from its tendency to soften in the sun)
to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring
tokens.kjv: boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
tokens.kjv: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.

tokens.bdb: a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria
